biblio.label: WO 2010135788 A1
biblio.title: Switchable magnetic implement
biblio.abstract: Described are switchable magnetic implements for use a work piece or tool holders and as jigs for machining or welding operations, the implement having at least two permanent magnets received within a housing having or comprised of at least two main pole pieces, one or both of the magnets being movable to selectively generate an external magnetic field and a magnetic flux path trough the pole pieces when in contact with a ferromagnetic work piece, which is characterised by including at least two pole extension members which are respectively secured, preferably in exchangeable manner, to the associated one of the main pole pieces, and in that the pole extension members have at least two engagement surfaces adapted to be brought into contact with two work pieces, the engagement surfaces being contoured to at least partially match the contours of differently shaped work pieces, eg provide a curved or non-rectilinear engagement or contact location as well as rectilinear contact / engagement surfaces at the same implement.

summary: This document discloses a switchable magnetic implement for securing workpieces, which can be used as a magnetic gripper, featuring movable magnets and pole extension members with optimized engagement surfaces for improved flux transfer.
